The BITwiki epistemic tier system integrates insights from multiple epistemological traditions:

1. '''Critical Rationalism''' (Popper, 1959): Knowledge claims remain conjectural and subject to refutation
2. '''Social Epistemology''' (Goldman, 1999; Kitcher, 1993): Knowledge production involves social processes requiring quality assessment
3. '''Virtue Epistemology''' (Zagzebski, 1996; Sosa, 2007): Epistemic agents and their practices matter for knowledge quality
4. '''Feminist Epistemology''' (Code, 1991; Harding, 1991): Situated knowledge and standpoint considerations affect confidence assessment

---
